meta.keys: cells[id] holds the MODIS values (aet_*) for each farmland square and 'rec', a key into records for the ERA5-Land and SMAP values shared by squares under the same pixels: records[cells[id].rec]
meta.low_typical_high: 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile of the seasons 2001-2020 (SMAP: 2016-2025)
meta.season: named by harvest year: season 2024 = September 2023 to August 2024

et0_month.what: reference evapotranspiration in each month, mm (multiply by a crop's Kc for its water need)

durum_need.what: durum water need over its 240-day season from 15 November (ET0 x Kc), mm

sm_root_month.what: root-zone soil water (0-100 cm) in each month, % volume, normal = 2016-2025

sm_sowing.what: root-zone soil water in November (sowing), % volume

sm_sowing_surface.what: top 5 cm soil water in November, % volume

sm_spring.what: root-zone soil water in March-April, % volume

durum_need_by_season.what: durum water need of each season, mm
durum_need_by_season.shape: one value per season in meta.seasons

sm_sowing_by_season.what: November root-zone soil water of each season (null before SMAP)

sm_spring_by_season.what: March-April root-zone soil water of each season (null before SMAP)

aet_season.what: water actually used by crops November-June (MODIS evapotranspiration on rain-fed arable pixels), mm

aet_by_season.what: MODIS water use of each season, mm
aet_by_season.shape: one value per season, in cells[id]

era5_land.name: ERA5-Land daily and monthly aggregates (ECMWF, Copernicus Climate Change Service)
era5_land.cite: Muñoz Sabater, J. (2019). ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present. C3S Climate Data Store. doi:10.24381/cds.e2161bac

modis_et.name: MODIS Terra evapotranspiration 8-day 500 m (MOD16A2GF gap-filled; MOD16A2 for the latest months)
modis_et.licence: NASA data: no restrictions on use
modis_et.cite: Running, S., Mu, Q., Zhao, M., Moreno, A. (2021). MOD16A2GF MODIS/Terra Net Evapotranspiration Gap-Filled 8-Day L4 Global 500 m SIN Grid V061. NASA LP DAAC. doi:10.5067/MODIS/MOD16A2GF.061

smap.name: NASA SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture, 3-hourly 9 km (SPL4SMGP v8)
smap.licence: Public domain (NASA Earth Science Data and Information Policy)
smap.cite: Reichle, R. et al. (2025). SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km EASE-Grid Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture Geophysical Data, Version 8. NASA NSIDC DAAC. doi:10.5067/T5RUATAQREF8

fao56.name: FAO-56 crop evapotranspiration guidelines (Penman-Monteith ET0, crop factors)
fao56.cite: Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56

meta.ai_assistance: Produced by notebooks written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) and run by the Field Shift team in Google Colab with Google Earth Engine. Data values come from the cited datasets and were not written by the AI, except a few published values from the trial at the demo field (its station's rain and temperature, and its soil description), which were copied by hand from Denora et al. (2025) and are labelled as such.
